goal: Align the kernel logging interface with the underlying singleton logging system
Stops misleading callers into assuming multiple independent logging configurations are supported
agreement: Support because a simpler global callback without separate connections is pragmatic (sedited)
Settled objection: prematurely restricting the logging API in a hard-to-reverse way (ryanofsky)
Settled concern: test state leakage resolved with an RAII logger wrapper (sedited, w0xlt)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it fixes misleading API semantics where per-connection handles implied independent loggers
External callers get a simpler interface while multiplexing can be handled upstream
